design: 32 tasks (8qa/8code/8tc/8cc) x F0/F1/F2 x 2reps, serial counterbalanced

deltas.F2_vs_F0: tools -31%, searches -60%, input +12% (packet cost), correctness -3 (within noise)
deltas.F2_vs_F1: input -34%, tools/srce equal — RDX delivers the same tool-call benefit at ~1/3 the token cost

reading: RepoDex reduces retrieval-side tool calls/searches but the packet costs net tokens and does not improve correctness on this code/test-heavy mix. RDX is the strictly better packet (same benefit, 34k fewer tokens).
